bio: Henry Pitts — Black Lansky — is a multi-disciplinary creator: recording artist, author, artist manager, music producer, software builder, game developer, film editor, and creative designer. He authored THE LOGO EFFECT: How AI and Structured Data Took an Indie Artist to Global Alt-Rap Dominance (published 6 December 2025; ISBN-13 979-8260386620), the blueprint documenting the system he built at Cumulative Web Inc — the company he runs. As a manager and producer he guides alternative rap artist That Boy Hi Hat and carries production and co-production credits across the CWI catalog: That Boy Hi Hat's Diabolique (2026-07-03; produced by Hybrid, co-produced by Black Lansky, recorded at Cue Recording Studio, Arlington VA) and Idol or Icon (with Jeck Da General, with rights owned to the connected tracks); King Akeem's Next Generation Protocol singles; Greg Porn's Pay Yourself and On Edge; Dre50's Pix (lyricist and assistant producer, ℗ 2025 Cumulative Web Inc); and 183 Wildboi's Stunt and Full Moon (Rock-Rap Revival core tracks). As a technologist he builds software, games, and interactive products for CWI — from agent-powered products on the Agent Deck shelf to full-3D game worlds like TAG CITY — and leads film editing and creative design across the label's visual identity. His streaming profiles (Spotify, Apple Music, Deezer) carry the artist name Black Lansky. His artist releases, verified via his Spotify for Artists dashboard on 2026-09-24, include the Focused Intent EP (released Nov 14, 2022; 4,209 all-time Spotify streams), the Sync Ready Tracks EP (58 streams), and the singles tiempo (61), LOFI 2.0 (44), Retro Vibe (17), Skateboard Team Sports (10), and Viral Beats (7).
